body:
Thank you, @vilts. The goal, the use cases and the open questions are clear, and they give the research a good start.

Triage:
- **P8** and **needs-research**: a large feature with open design questions (the folder model, the order of the copies, expanded moves or subprograms in the post, the checks for each copy). The research answers them here, then files the concrete sub-issues for code.
- **effort:max**: it changes posted G-code and the collision and gouge checks (the safety floor), and it needs new design.
- **area:post**, **area:sim**

## Research answers

### 1. Folder

Use a named pattern folder entity inside the setup, not a separate setup.

- **Evidence:** `crates/app/src/schema.rs` stores one WCS per setup (`SetupDef::wcs`, `#342`). `crates/app/src/program_entry.rs` (`ProgramEntry`) and `crates/app/src/project/program_entry_dto.rs` show how a non-operation row sits in the `Operations` list of a setup.
- **Model:** Add a `PatternDef` component in `crates/app/src/schema.rs` with `setup: Option<String>`, `OperationMeta::order`, `suppressed: bool`, `kind`, `order_mode`, `members: Vec<String>`, and `disabled_instances: Vec<u32>`.
- **Single WCS:** All copies use the WCS of the parent setup.
- **Nesting:** Refuse a folder inside another folder in version 1. Nesting adds complex index maps and transform rules without solving the primary use cases.
- **Skip one copy:** Store 0-based disabled copy indices in `disabled_instances`. Copy `0` is the source position. The user can turn off any copy, such as a position under a clamp.
- **Membership:** An operation belongs to at most one folder in the same setup. When an operation regenerates, all copies read its updated `Toolpath`.

### 2. Order of the copies

Make the copy order a folder setting (`PatternOrder`) with two values: `ByTool` (default) and `ByPart`.

- **Evidence:** `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` writes a `TOOL` record before each `SECTION`. `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` (`onToolChange`, `startPreamble`) writes `T.. M6`, `G43 H..`, `M5`, and `M3` for every `SECTION`, even when the tool number stays the same.
- **By tool (`ByTool`, default):** Run each operation in folder order across all enabled copies before the next operation starts. Combine all enabled copies of one operation into one `SECTION` with safe clearance-plane rapids between copies. This avoids redundant tool changes on all shipped posts and keeps operation order (such as rough before finish, or drill before tap).
- **By part (`ByPart`):** Run all operations in the folder at one enabled copy, then move to the next enabled copy.
- **Rest material:** `crates/app/src/rest.rs` computes rest material at copy `0`. Both `ByTool` and `ByPart` keep folder operation order at every copy.

### 3. Posted output

Use expanded moves as the default output for all posts. Add optional `G52` local coordinate shifts and subprograms in a later slice for verified posts only.

- **Evidence:** All 11 shipped milling posts live in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (`BUILTINS`) and `assets/posts/*.cps`. None of them currently emit `M98`/`M99`, `M97`, `CALL LBL`, `O<sub> call`, `G52`, `ATRANS`, or `CYCL DEF 7`:
  - `fanuc.cps`, `haas.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps`, `mazak.cps`, `sinumerik.cps`, `heidenhain.cps`, `grblhal.cps`, `carvera.cps`, `tinyg.cps`: `workOffsetMax = 6`.
  - `tormach.cps`: `workOffsetMax = 9` (`G54`..`G59.3`).
  - `mach4.cps`: `workOffsetMax = 254` (`G54`..`G59`, `G54.1 P1..P248`).
- **Expanded moves (default):** Works on all 11 milling posts immediately. Keeps `viewer_map` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` exact for every line.
- **No work offset per copy:** Nine milling posts support only 6 offsets, and a work offset cannot mirror.
- **Optional compact output (later slice):** Gate `G52` and subprograms (`M98`/`M99`, `M97`, or LinuxCNC `O<sub> call`, per RS-274 / ISO 6983 and public control manuals) behind explicit post manifest flags (`assets/posts/AGENTS.md`). Refuse any post that does not declare support. Cancel `G52 X0. Y0. Z0.` before every tool change and at program end.

### 4. Circular pattern

Support indexed rotary patterns around `A` or `B` as the primary circular mode, and also allow planar `Z` rotation around a center point for 3-axis mills.

- **Evidence:** `crates/cl/src/cl/frame.rs` (`TiltedFrame`) and `crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs` define tilted tool axes and RS-274 `A`/`B`/`C` conversion. `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting_index_swing.rs`, and `crates/app/src/posting_swing_standing.rs` already check rotary travel and index swing clearance.
- **Change from suggestion:** The requester suggested skipping 3-axis XY circular patterns. However, nesting (`#2166`) already requires a 2D XY rotation transform `(tx, ty, angle_deg)` in `crates/cl/`. Adding `PlanarZ { center }` beside `RotaryA` and `RotaryB` reuses that exact transform at low cost and serves 3-axis bolt circles and radial features.
- **Rotary checks:** Indexed `A`/`B` copies must retract to safe Z before each index and pass `pose_problems`, `index_swing`, and `swing_standing`. Column stock simulation refuses posed moves (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`, `POSED_REFUSAL`) and shows the visible not-judged line.

### 5. Mirror and cut direction

Make cut direction a mirror folder setting (`MirrorCutDirection`) with two values: `PreserveClimb` (default) and `GeometricMirror`.

- **Evidence:** `crates/post/src/post/invert.rs` and `crates/post/src/post/wcs_flip.rs` implement RS-274 / ISO 6983 reflection laws. Reflection across one in-plane axis negates coordinates across the mirror plane, flips `arc.ccw` (`G2` <-> `G3`), and swaps `CompSide` (`G41` <-> `G42`). A Z-axis mirror is refused (`crates/post/src/post/wcs_flip.rs`).
- **Allowed planes:** Allow vertical mirror planes only (`nz == 0`). Refuse horizontal or tilted mirror planes by name.
- **GeometricMirror:** Reflect all moves, cycles, and compensation spans in place. This preserves entry ramps, plunges, and roughing stepover order, while changing climb milling to conventional milling.
- **PreserveClimb (default):** Safely reverse planar cutting passes after entry and before retract (swapping lead-in and lead-out, keeping original `arc.ccw` and `CompSide`) for 2D contours, profiles, and chamfers. Refuse by name any operation whose entry or engagement cannot reverse safely (helical ramps, adaptive clearing, multi-pass roughing) and direct the user to choose `GeometricMirror`. Never reverse a plunge or ramp into solid stock (AGENTS.md "Never Crash, Never Gouge").
- **Refused kinds:** Refuse turning, threading, probing, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and tilted 5-axis moves in a mirror folder until each kind is verified.

### 6. Checks of the copies

Every enabled copy runs through the binding post gate (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `verification_report_by`). Any failure names the folder, copy index, and operation, and blocks the post.

- **Source gate:** Every member operation must be generated, fresh (`OpStatus::Ok`), and free of blocking warnings (`posting::program_ops`).
- **Fixture collision:** Run `crates/app/src/fixture_struck.rs` (`op_hits`) on every enabled copy and every inter-copy rapid link against turning fixtures, fixed fixtures, closed meshes, and the machine table.
- **Machine limits:** Run `crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs` (`check_ops`) on every enabled copy for X/Y/Z travel, feeds, and rotary limits. Run `posting_index_swing.rs` and `posting_swing_standing.rs` for rotary copies.
- **Stock bounds (pattern):** Check that every enabled pattern copy stays inside the setup stock XY bounds (within `0.01 mm` for the transformed cut region) and cuts stock. Refuse off-stock copies by copy index.
- **Stock simulation:** Feed all enabled copies in program order into `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` (`plan_program`). `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/deviate.rs` blocks on any gouge into the model.
- **Full model checks (mirror):** Run model gouge, shank, and rapid-in-stock checks (`crates/sim/src/verify/`, `crates/app/src/operation/kept_rejudge.rs`) on every mirrored toolpath against the full part mesh.

### 7. Commands and MCP

All folder actions use undoable `Command` types in `crates/app/src/commands/` and matching MCP tools in `crates/app/src/mcp/` (AGENTS.md "Everything Is a Command").

- **Evidence:** `crates/app/src/commands/program_entry.rs`, `crates/app/src/commands/operation/meta.rs`, and `crates/app/src/mcp/order_tools.rs` define the command and MCP patterns for sequenced setup items.
- **Commands and MCP tools:**
  - `CreatePatternFolder` / `create_pattern_folder`
  - `EditPatternFolder` / `edit_pattern_folder`
  - `SetPatternMembers` / `set_pattern_members`
  - `SetPatternInstanceEnabled` (or via `EditPatternFolder`) / `set_pattern_instance_enabled`
  - `DeletePatternFolder` (ungroups members by default) / `delete_pattern_folder`
  - Extend `ReorderOperation` and `RenameOperation` to support folders, and include folders in `get_job` (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`).

### 8. Relation to nesting (#2166)

Yes. Toolpath patterns and nesting (`#2166`) share one pure transform module in `crates/cl/`.

- **Evidence:** `#2166` (currently blocked on `#2158`, `#2160`, `#2161`) replicates 2.5D/3D router operations to placed `(tx, ty, angle_deg)` instances. `crates/cl/` already owns `Toolpath`, `Move`, `Cycle`, `CompSpan`, `EdgeBreak`, `ProbeTouch`, `PlasmaCut`, and `TiltedFrame`.
- **Shared API:** Place `crates/cl/src/cl/transform.rs` in `camcraft-cl` (no new crate dependency; `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-sim`, and `camcraft-post` already depend on it). Expose `translate`, `transform_xy`, `rotate_about_axis`, and `mirror_plane`. Nesting (`#2166`) calls `transform_xy` directly.

---

## Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

1. **Slice 1 (pure CL transforms):** Add `crates/cl/src/cl/transform.rs` with micron-accurate translation, XY rotation, axis rotation, vertical-plane mirroring, and safe 2D pass reversal.
2. **Slice 2 (smallest end-to-end slice):** Add `PatternDef` schema, project save/load, undoable commands, MCP tools, and expanded-move posting for linear and grid patterns with `ByTool` and `ByPart` order and per-copy disable.
3. **Slice 3 (safety gate and simulation):** Wire expanded pattern copies into fixture checks, stock-bounds checks, machine travel checks, and `stock_sim::simulate_document`.
4. **Slice 4 (mirror folder):** Add vertical-plane mirror mode (`PreserveClimb` default and `GeometricMirror`) with full model gouge, shank, rapid, and stock-simulation verification.
5. **Slice 5 (circular pattern):** Add indexed rotary (`A`/`B`) circular patterns with swing/travel checks and planar `Z` circular patterns for 3-axis mills.
6. **Slice 6 (UI):** Add collapsible pattern and mirror folder rows in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`, an inspector panel, per-copy toggles, and viewport toolpath preview.
7. **Slice 7 (compact post output):** Add opt-in `G52` local shift and subprogram (`M98`/`M99`, `O<sub> call`) output for verified posts behind explicit manifest flags.

---

## Planned sub-issues

1. **CL toolpath transforms: translate, rotate in XY, rotate about an axis, and mirror across a plane**
   - Adds pure `crates/cl/src/cl/transform.rs` shared by patterns, mirrors, and `#2166` nesting.
   - Done means: unit tests verify translation, XY rotation, A/B axis rotation, vertical-plane mirroring (`G2`/`G3` and `G41`/`G42` swap), safe 2D pass reversal under `PreserveClimb`, and named refusals for unsupported records.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (safety floor: geometry and toolpath transforms), `area:post`.

2. **Pattern folder: schema, undoable commands, MCP tools, project save, and linear or grid expanded posting**
   - Adds `PatternDef`, linear and grid modes, `ByTool` and `ByPart` order, per-copy disable, undoable commands, MCP tools, `.cam` persistence, and expanded-move posting.
   - Done means: tests create, edit, undo, redo, save, and reload linear and grid folders via commands and MCP, disable one copy, and pin golden NC output for `ByTool` (no redundant tool changes) and `ByPart`.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (safety floor: posted G-code), `area:post`, `area:mcp`.

3. **Pattern verification and stock simulation: check stock bounds, fixture hits, machine travel, and simulate all copies**
   - Expands all enabled pattern copies in `stock_sim`, fixture collision checks, machine travel checks, and a new stock-bounds check.
   - Done means: tests prove that a copy hitting a clamp, leaving stock bounds, exceeding machine travel, or gouging the model blocks the post by copy index, disabling that copy passes, and `simulate_document` cuts all enabled copies.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (safety floor: collision, gouge, and stock simulation), `area:sim`, `area:post`.

4. **Mirror folder: mirror operations across a vertical plane with PreserveClimb setting and full model verification**
   - Adds vertical-plane mirror mode (`PreserveClimb` default vs `GeometricMirror`), full model gouge/shank/rapid checks on mirrored paths, and mirrored posting.
   - Done means: tests mirror a symmetrical part across an X or Y plane, verify `PreserveClimb` preserves climb on 2D contours and refuses unsafe multi-pass reversal by name, verify `GeometricMirror` flips `G2`/`G3` and `G41`/`G42`, and prove a mirrored gouge blocks the post.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (safety floor: posted G-code, gouge checks, stock simulation), `area:post`, `area:sim`.

5. **Circular pattern: indexed rotary copies around A or B, plus optional planar XY rotation about Z**
   - Adds circular pattern mode (count and angle step) for indexed `A`/`B` rotary axes with swing and travel checks, plus planar `Z` rotation around a center point.
   - Done means: tests post an indexed 4-sided A-axis pattern with safe retract before each index, refuse indexing when travel or `index_swing` clearance fails, and post and simulate a planar XY circular pattern on a 3-axis mill.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (safety floor: posted G-code and rotary collision checks), `area:multiaxis`, `area:post`, `area:sim`.

6. **Pattern and mirror UI: setup tree folder node, inspector panel, per-copy toggle, and viewport preview**
   - Adds collapsible folder rows in `browser_tree.rs`, an inspector panel for pattern/mirror settings and copy toggles, and replicated toolpath rendering in the viewport.
   - Done means: UI behaviour and layout tests create a folder, assign operations, toggle one copy off, show copy-level gate errors, and verify all edits run undoable commands.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (new UI behaviour with new behaviour and layout tests), `area:ui`.

7. **Compact pattern posting: opt-in G52 local coordinate shift and M98/M99 subprograms for verified posts**
   - Adds an opt-in compact post output mode for linear and grid patterns using `G52` and subprograms on posts that declare manifest support.
   - Done means: golden NC tests and a coordinate-interpreter check prove `G52`/subprogram output matches expanded moves, cancels `G52 X0. Y0. Z0.` before tool changes and program end, and refuses posts without manifest support by name.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high` (safety floor: posted G-code), `area:post`.

Filed the concrete sub-issues in dependency order:

1. #3011 — CL toolpath transforms: translate, rotate in XY, rotate about an axis, and mirror across a plane (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
2. #3012 — Pattern folder: schema, undoable commands, MCP tools, project save, and linear or grid expanded posting (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:mcp`) — depends on #3011
3. #3013 — Pattern verification and stock simulation: check stock bounds, fixture hits, machine travel, and simulate all copies (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`, `area:post`) — depends on #3012
4. #3014 — Mirror folder: mirror operations across a vertical plane with PreserveClimb setting and full model verification (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:sim`) — depends on #3011, #3012, #3013
5. #3015 — Circular pattern: indexed rotary copies around A or B, plus optional planar XY rotation about Z (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:post`, `area:sim`) — depends on #3011, #3012, #3013
6. #3016 — Pattern and mirror UI: setup tree folder node, inspector panel, per-copy toggle, and viewport preview (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:ui`) — depends on #3012, #3014, #3015
7. #3017 — Compact pattern posting: opt-in G52 local coordinate shift and M98/M99 subprograms for verified posts (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`) — depends on #3012

This umbrella stays open with `needs-research` until the maintainer reviews the proposal and sub-issues.
